name: Menu / service page
blurb: Food, nail, detailing, lawn — any business type.

factors.label: Number of items
values: Under 10 items or services
20+ items, multiple categories

factors.label: Content provided
values: Client sends a clean, organized list
Client has nothing ready, built from scratch

factors.label: Photos needed
values: No photos, text only
Each item needs a photo (stock or provided)

factors.label: Layout complexity
values: Simple list or basic grid
Tabbed sections, filters, or category headers

factors.label: For example
values: Lawn care — 5 services listed
Restaurant — full food menu with sections, prices, photos

name: Catering / quote page
blurb: Lead capture for large or scheduled jobs.

factors.label: Page structure
values: Basic inquiry form + contact info
Full packages displayed + pricing tiers + form

factors.label: Content provided
values: Client has their packages written out
Content organised and written for them

factors.label: Form complexity
values: Name, email, message, submit
Event date, guest count, menu selections, special requests

factors.label: For example
values: Detailer — request a quote form only
Restaurant — full catering packages with photos and pricing

name: Booking integration
blurb: Calendly, Square, Booksy or similar setup.

factors.label: Platform
values: Calendly — straightforward embed
Square, Vagaro, or custom system needing configuration

factors.label: Client setup
values: Client already has an account set up and ready
Account set up and services configured for them

factors.label: Number of service types
values: One booking type (e.g. appointments)
Multiple service types, staff members, or locations

factors.label: Testing required
values: Basic embed test
Full end-to-end booking flow testing

factors.label: For example
values: Nail salon with Calendly already set up
Detailer with multiple services, packages, and time slots

name: Website update (one-time)
blurb: Photos, text, hours, name changes. Separate from the monthly allowance in Growth and Pro.

factors.label: Scope
values: Single change — phone number, hours, one photo swap
2–4 changes across the site
5+ changes or one major section rewrite

factors.label: Time estimate
values: Under 15 minutes
15–30 minutes
30–60 minutes

factors.label: For example
values: Update business hours
Swap 3 photos + update prices
Rewrite services section + new photos throughout

name: Google Ads management
blurb: Built once, then run month to month. Your ad budget is paid to Google and I take no percentage of it.

factors.label: Keyword research
values: The full build — search terms, competitors, match types
Re-cut each month against what people actually searched

factors.label: Ad copy
values: Every ad group written and launched
Rewritten where the numbers say to

factors.label: Conversion tracking
values: Installed on your site and tested end to end
Checked that it is still firing

factors.label: Negative keywords
values: A starting list, before a dollar is spent
Pruned against the real search terms report

factors.label: Your report
values: One a month, in plain English

factors.label: For example
values: A detailer going live on Google for the first time
The same detailer in month four, paying less per call
